precedence: 2. If bulk_primary === true OR format === 'bulk_export': preferred_tier = cad-export; resolve adapter_kind → parser + bulk source.
3. Attempt cad-export ingest. On success: every upserted row records tier=cad-export (and adapter_kind).

4. Fallback to stratmap-roll is ALLOWED only as a NAMED fallback: CLI must pass --allow-stratmap-fallback (or stratmap-landuse must refuse bulk_primary counties unless that flag is set). Fallback rows record tier=stratmap-roll. Silent fallback is forbidden.
5. Counties without bulk_primary keep current behavior (explicit CAD county registry OR explicit stratmap-landuse) but still stamp the tier they actually used.
